name: TREE_AGENT_TIMEOUT_S
desc: The limit of a tree agent's command, in seconds. Harbor's agent timeout of each task ends the run first.

name: STEP_SIZE
desc: The rollouts in one optimizer step: each batch here trains as one step.

name: READ_RESULT_CHARS
desc: A file the session read is the repository's content the change starts from: kept longer than other results.

name: BUCKET_COUNT
desc: The number of buckets for conversations. A weight is a number of buckets.

name: DEFAULT_MAX_SESSIONS
desc: Ceiling on live sessions. The fallback opens one session per unmatched request, so without a ceiling a client it never matches grows the table with the request rate for a whole TTL, and every scan pays for it.

name: CONTROL_REPLY_LIMIT_BYTES
desc: The most of a control reply that the client reads.

name: SCORING_CONCURRENCY
desc: Scoring requests in flight at once; the engine batches them, and the columns are installed only once every row is in.

name: MAX_ARTIFACT_LAG
desc: How many artifacts behind the served one a row may be and still train. A test appends rows before the jobs that it waits for move the served artifact, so its rows stay trainable until it ends.

name: MAX_TASK_DIRECTORY_ENTRIES
desc: The most entries, files and directories, directly in one directory of a task: the Hugging Face Hub's limit.

name: PROMPT_TOKEN_LIMIT
desc: The cookbook's prompt-only cap, in tokens of the model pair's tokenizer.

name: FAILURE_POLL_S
desc: How often a waiting future re-checks the executor for a terminal failure.

name: METRIC_DELAY_S
desc: How long the counters of a finished request may take to reach the engine's metrics.

name: DEFAULT_TRIAL_TIMEOUT_S
desc: How long one trial of the agent may take when the method's ``trial_timeout_s`` says nothing.

name: LOOP_LOG_CHARS
desc: Serialized characters one ``ctx.log`` event may carry; a loop cannot fill the session with one call.

name: import_record
doc: Persist an existing inference or report through ordinary admission.

name: selections
doc: Previews of client requests, without the readiness previews Reef sends when it starts.

name: fetch_version
doc: Fetch ``version`` from the remote and return its commit id.

name: _trained_composite
doc: A composite of a harness recipe and the config recipe, and the live objects that run the harness jobs

name: from_bytes
doc: Read the bytes of ``BASE_FILE``; ``ValueError`` when they are no ``to_dict`` value.

name: validate_candidate
doc: Check the candidate privately, without Docker or any ownership change, and return its snapshot version.

name: local_inference_component
doc: Start an inference component on this host, and record its address as the ``inference.remote`` section.

name: replay_page
doc: Read at most a positive ``limit`` after a nonnegative append sequence.

name: live_objects
doc: The live objects of a test deployment that trains weights: the training component ``component``, its facts

name: setup
doc: Nothing to install: the image carries the runner and the reference's split.

name: produce
doc: Make samples of the records that the trainer of ``component`` in ``scenario`` has not used yet, and store

name: validate_services
doc: Services with valid commands and unique names, checked before any process starts.

name: _serve
doc: Answer RPCs until the owner sends the ``None`` stop request.
